column7: SUMO Quantity broadly includes numbers, physical quantities, and other quantifiable entities, while math:Quantity is the stricter GMEOW class of objects carrying exactly one explicit math:Dimension. The logic-owned SUMO boundary therefore records a broad, validation-only bridge rather than an equivalence or imported semantic spine.
